## Checklist
- [ ] Title uses Conventional Commits (e.g., `feat:`, `fix:`, `ci:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / chaos where relevant)
- [ ] Security considered (input validation, XSS, secrets, crypto, permissions)
- [ ] Accessibility considered (semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard, contrast)
- [ ] Low-data-mode considered (bundle size, images, offline/PWA behavior)
- [ ] Lint passes locally (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Build passes locally (`npm run build`)
